}}'''Meralda''' is a [[Tear|Tairen]] woman and a member of [[Cha Faile]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Meralda Belmondes}}

== Appearance ==
She is tall and very dark. She is almost 5'7 tall.

She is bold and quick with her tongue, but was overawed easily by a look from [[Selande Darengil|Selande]]. Meralda had no doubt that Selande was in charge of Cha Faile.

== Activities ==
She follows [[Faile Bashere]] to [[Ghealdan]]. She is sent into [[Bethal]] in disguise to plot the layout of the city.
